objective: Test whether leakage-safe expected contact and damage quality for the exact T-5 lineup versus the opposing confirmed starter improves full-game winner probability beyond the frozen V16 C4 control, while preserving V62 as a diagnostic benchmark only.

parentEvidence.v63Interpretation: Micro-cell pitch-shape matching improved V16 C4 point estimates but failed frozen bootstrap and temporal-stability gates and underperformed V62; V64 must not reuse post-result V63 bucket tuning.

hypothesis.statement: A lower-variance representation of how well each exact T-5 lineup is expected to make contact and do damage against the opposing starter can retain matchup information without fragmenting batter history into sparse four-dimensional pitch-shape cells.
hypothesis.mechanism: starter arsenal quality and handedness -> batter contact/discipline/damage expectation -> lineup-level expected contact and damage differential -> full-game win probability

featureEngineering.principle: Use broad, leakage-safe batter outcome/contact priors conditioned only on opposing starter handedness and frozen starter quality context. Do not use V63 local pitch-shape cells or any post-result bandwidth search.
featureEngineering.batterHistorySource: V41 direct batter historical custody, prior official dates only
featureEngineering.handednessSource: V60 exact pregame batter/starter hand custody

definitions.expected_contact_rate_vs_starter: PA-weighted lineup expectation of (H + BB - K) / PA after 100-PA shrinkage against the starter handedness bucket.
definitions.expected_damage_per_pa_vs_starter: PA-weighted lineup expectation of TB / PA after 100-PA shrinkage against the starter handedness bucket.
definitions.expected_hr_per_pa_vs_starter: PA-weighted lineup expectation of HR / PA after 100-PA shrinkage against the starter handedness bucket.
definitions.starterQualityInteraction: The challenger receives the frozen V62 starter-quality variables unchanged alongside the eight lineup contact/damage variables; no multiplication term search is permitted.

diagnosticBenchmark.name: V62_PITCH_QUALITY_WINNER
diagnosticBenchmark.purpose: V62 is compared descriptively to determine whether V64 recovers the stronger starter-matchup signal without sparse V63 cells; failing to beat V62 does not alter the pre-frozen V64 pass rubric against V16 C4.
